findings.claim: Q3 2026 LEU segment revenue $31.8M vs $44.8M (-29%), attributed to contract mix shift; total revenue $55.5M vs $74.9M; contingent LEU+HALEU enrichment backlog $5.4B
findings.source: Centrus Q3 2026 results (SEC 8-K ex99.1 / oilprice coverage)

findings.claim: Q3 2026 SWU average price +10%, volume +19%; LEU segment revenue down 29%
findings.excerpt: Revenue from the LEU segment was $31.8 million and $44.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, a decrease of $13.0 million or 29%.

findings.claim: WNA 2025 Nuclear Fuel Report: reactor uranium demand >150,000 tU by 2040, upper case 204,000 tU
findings.excerpt: a series of reports published by World Nuclear Association and its predecessor organisation the Uranium Institute at roughly two-yearly intervals since 1975. Launched in London today at World Nuclear Association Symposium 2019, it includes three scenarios - designated Reference, Upper and Lower - covering a range of possibilities for nuclear power to 2040.

findings.claim: DOE does not currently plan to exercise further options under HALEU operation contract; FY2027 budget omits HALEU cascade funding

end_markets.note: 搜尋摘要為二手轉述，未取得逐字原文。SWU 價格：Q1 +52%、Q2 +3%、Q3 +10%（出處為搜尋彙總，未核）。FY2027 預算提案未含 HALEU cascade 資金（約$0.8B backlog 受影響）；FY2026 營收指引$450–500M。WNA 2025 報告 2040 鈾需求約150,000 tU（參考情境），upper case 204,000 tU。均未讀到逐字原文，僅列為線索。 線索 3 條，程式核實 2 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
